html_source: Hanni Bailey's simplified map of Dublin with added arrows showing the church from which Conmee and the sailor begin their opposite-direction journeys (green), Conmee's passing of O'Neill's (red), the sailor's passing of 7 Eccles (blue), and the location of St. Mary's Chapter House in section 8 (orange). Source: Anderson, James Joyce.
